items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, with Haroldin. Yeah, with Haroldin now. I thought you heard him while he was in your home at you? No, no, no. [INTERVIEWEE] I didn't know him then.

ctx.x: Well around that time it was down at Haydell's Melody Inn.
Oh, with Haroldin. Yeah, with Haroldin now. I thought you heard him while he was in your home at you? No, no, no.
